map.水分≤6%、溶化性 pass、RSD≤5%、含量 95~105%、微生物 pas: Moisture <=6%, solubility pass, RSD <=5%, content 95-105%, microbe pass, particle size <=15% means all six items pass and the batch is judged conforming.
